trigger: ЛПР: первым релизом блок самообучения; остальное сдвинуть, разбить на много маленьких релизов; обрывы не должны приводить к потере/повтору работы; закрепить в AIR_VIBECODING и ядре AirWorker.
release_gate_policy: Source-only development allowed; tag/release only after exact signed acceptance and explicit LPR authorization, installation/UAC/reboot/foreign services separately approved.

interval_policy.source_change_budget: one independently demonstrable effect per step, target <=2 source files plus focused tests; break if larger
interval_policy.model_or_qa_long_job: submit once with immutable job_id/source SHA; status readback is a separate step, no duplicate dispatch
interval_policy.interruption_recovery: read PLAN + release-slices.json + Git HEAD/remote/dirty + native RUNNING/DONE/FAILED receipts and process roster before any mutation; resume only earliest OPEN step
interval_policy.checkpoint: atomic scoped commit + remote readback + immutable JSON receipt before next mutation; do not synthesize PASS on missing information
interval_policy.freeze: scoped tests then freeze clean SHA -> one full QA/vet/build + independent Sol -> release receipt; no unrelated fixes after freeze
interval_policy.defects: only security P0/P1 on active release are in critical path; other findings become deferred next release, preserving original node
interval_policy.parallel: one owner per file; one heavy Go or Codex task at a time; unfinished foreign WIP must not be staged or cleaned
interval_policy.metadata: UTC receipt/run timestamps with SGT reporting

execution_order: AirWorker executor dispatch -class complex; Codex tier auto-selected
after first terminal readback: AirWorker executor dispatch -class bulk; Codex tier auto-selected
lpr_authorized_codex_execution.independent_judge: AirWorker review code pinned Codex gpt-6-sol low read-only, on exact source SHA
